_about: Code Relay mission nodes (mission-framework CR). Mission part only: validate with Sector Ops' campus plan graphs, `node scripts/level-validate.mjs docs/sector-redesign/graph/plan/campusOps-S{1,2,3,4,5}.json <this file>` (mission-validator branch). Space and sync ids are Sector Ops' (origin/feature/sector-redesign-signoff fe3ef35f, graph/plan/campusOps-S4.json `syncs`; the extraction s4-cc is that file's `tracks.exfil`, not a space tag). Rules: 2 (Michael's cap); the 3-rule variant with Vault's noBodies is the sign-off's option 2, not in this file. `sync` on an objective names the campus sync node the step uses; `target`, `decoys`, `bolt`, `window`, `soloWindow` are MissionDef fields (PLAN section 2), not validator fields. Beat chart: BEAT.md; notes: BEAT.md 'Graph notes'.

objectives.text: Over the generator compound to the roof deck (a leg-up onto the plant ladder, or alone up the cable riser); hear who has the NOC tonight
objectives.hint: The plant ladder is on the east wall: one gives the other a leg-up. Alone, the riser door at the compound's dark north end takes the dock code.

objectives.text: Read the dock board for the door codes, between the dock pair's trips
objectives.hint: The board is at the west end of the dock, by the goods door into the lobby.

objectives.text: Down the cable riser to the north corridor; loop the hall cameras at the security desk
objectives.hint: The side door from the north corridor is behind the operator. The supervisor sits by the panel.

objectives.text: Through the dark battery room to the cage; get inside and wait at the terminal
objectives.hint: Cold aisles under the cable baskets are the dark way. The keyholder never turns round.

objectives.text: Up to the NOC; make the duty officer issue a cage release
objectives.hint: Two at the window. Deal with the other one first, quietly. Then ask the right one.

objectives.text: Enter the release at the cage terminal and pull the build and signing logs
objectives.hint: Be at the terminal before Relay asks. Thirty seconds is not long.

objectives.text: Keep the cage clear: the release has called the mobile supervisor
objectives.hint: He walks the west aisle to the centre aisle. Relay can see all of it.

objectives.text: Optional: wipe tonight's footage at the security desk
objectives.hint: The footage is on the desk. It takes longer than a loop. Do it when the room is quiet.

objectives.text: Everyone out through the UPS room and down the colonnade
objectives.hint: The UPS room door is in the hall's north-west corner. The colonnade sentry faces east, into the corridor.

rules.text: Team Relay - question only the duty officer

tracks.name: Relay
tracks.note: Compound, riser, north corridor, security room and the NOC above it. The roof deck (y 7.3) covers the whole block: Relay's by height, y >= 7.3 (EN2).

tracks.name: Vault
tracks.note: Dock, lobby, battery room, hall and cage (ground). The colonnade (zone c4) is in neither track: shared.
